newsitem.title: USA: Vari-L Co converts $3.3 mln in debentures.
newsitem.headline: Vari-L Co converts $3.3 mln in debentures.

text.p: Vari-L Co Inc said Friday that about 65 percent, or about $3.3 million, of the $5 million in convertible debentures issued in March have been converted into an equity investment in the company.
The move resulted in the issuance of about 563,000 new shares of common stock, the company said.

The capital raised in the convertible debenture was used to accelerate expansion of Vari-L's international sales and marketing programs and to move forward with a manufacturing joint venture in the People's Republic of China, the company said.
